design.excluded: none: 3000/3000 clean, zero empty, zero truncated, zero batch errors

normalization.why: generation hygiene flagged 100% markdown and 97% headline-echo title lines (formatting the plain-prose human baseline lacks; guard: experiments/ablation/generation_hygiene.py). The normalizer drops the echoed headline block and unwraps markdown syntax, preserving every word of article prose. Quote style is untouched (the metric normalizes typographic quotes, R1-5).
normalization.effect: load-bearing: raw scoring understated the authorship gap (markdown scaffolding inflated variance): control B_n delta +0.022 (rb 0.21) raw vs +0.069 (rb 0.58) normalized. Raw scoring archived beside the normalized eval on the HF dataset.
normalization.note: deepseek-v4-pro (23-38% title lines) and grok-4.3 (47% markdown) are scored raw; a uniform normalization re-score across all legs is an open protocol decision (S4).

scoring.test: one paired Wilcoxon signed-rank per (mode, metric) over 200 seed-averaged headline pairs, delta = human - model

generation.driver: bench/gen_vllm.py via bench/reproducibility-scripts/ (2x A40, TP=2, vLLM offline batching, BENCH_THINKING=0)

provenance: Generated on RunPod (volume ssmlzb42af, pod gemma3-burstiness-full) at pinned repo ref 3fcd241; hygiene-gated, normalized, and scored locally against the frozen human baseline on the post-R1-5 metric; compiled eval carried into the repo as SSOT.
